entities.summary: AHHAA Science Centre is a science discovery destination in Tartu, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A dense hands-on science centre with live demonstrations and experiments strong enough to anchor a day in Tartu for families. This entry is intended for 5–14 travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.

entities.summary: PROTO Invention Factory is a immersive discovery destination in Tallinn, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A compact but distinctive invention-and-VR environment that turns industrial heritage into participatory play. This entry is intended for 7–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
